recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key, close-up portrait of a man in a dark cowboy hat, featuring a layered typographic treatment where a thin, geometric sans-serif name is overlaid by a textured, calligraphic script title across the chest area.
coreVisualRelationships: Dark hat brim framing the eyes against a bright, neutral background
Thin geometric lines of the primary text contrasting with the organic curves of the script
Text placement anchored to the subject's torso to create depth
Cool-toned shadows in the clothing and background balancing warm skin tones
coreInvariants: Subject wearing a black felt or straw cowboy hat
White textured t-shirt as the primary canvas for text
Soft, diffused lighting with minimal harsh shadows
Two-tier typographic hierarchy using contrasting styles

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up, subject centered horizontally, head slightly tilted, filling the upper two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark cowboy hat acts as the primary visual weight at the top, while the text block anchors the bottom third.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's gaze, move down to the large sans-serif name, and settle on the decorative script below.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample bright, desaturated space around the head and shoulders to emphasize the subject and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white and light grey (background and shirt)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted blue-grey (script text and subtle shirt shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, low-saturation palette with high-contrast black elements for readability.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones, blacks, and whites

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses ultra-light strokes with uniform thickness
Secondary text uses variable-width strokes with high-contrast flourishes
Script text features a 'stamped' or distressed texture
characterSpecificRedesigns: Large, open counters in the sans-serif
Exaggerated swashes on the initial and terminal letters of the script

composition.position: Directly below or slightly overlapping the display text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between a rigid, modern sans-serif and a traditional, textured script.
graphicDevices: Subtle horizontal alignment across the chest
Texture overlay on the script to suggest a printed garment effect

preserve: The overlap between the two styles

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean, geometric skeleton for the primary name.
Offers the necessary calligraphic flourishes for the secondary title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-key studio portrait of a man with light stubble wearing a black cowboy hat and a plain white t-shirt. The background is a soft, out-of-focus white wall. Lighting is bright and even.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the artist's name in a large, thin, black geometric sans-serif across the chest. Overlay a smaller, textured blue-grey script title slightly below it, allowing the script to overlap the bottom of the sans-serif letters.

verificationChecks: Is the hat the darkest element in the image?
Is the primary text thin enough to appear elegant rather than heavy?
Does the script text have a visible distressed texture?
Is the subject's gaze direct and clear?

adjustableVariables: Amount of texture on the script font
Tightness of the tracking on the sans-serif font
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
Unique facial features of a specific celebrity
Specific brand marks on the hat

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between subject and typography
avoid: Poorly integrated text that looks 'pasted on'

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the sans-serif text is perfectly centered.
Verify the script text has a subtle 'stamped' look.
Check that the lighting on the face is soft with no harsh shadows.
Confirm the background remains neutral and bright.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key male portrait in a cowboy hat with a two-layered typographic lockup: a thin geometric sans-serif base and a textured script overlay.
